questions.q: What are the three deliverables of this capstone?
options: A slide deck, a budget, and a résumé
A live endpoint, a secured endpoint, and a monitored endpoint
A whitepaper, a diagram, and a cost estimate
A trained model, a dataset, and a notebook
questions.explain: The capstone requires an endpoint that is actually deployed and healthy, secured without hardcoded secrets, and monitored with diagnostic logs flowing somewhere.

questions.q: Which earlier lessons does the "secured endpoint" deliverable pull from?
options: Lesson 1 and Lesson 2 only
Lesson 17 and Lesson 18 (AWS and Google Vertex AI)
Lesson 14 (networking) and Lesson 16 (managed identities & Key Vault)
Lesson 23 and Lesson 24
questions.explain: Securing the endpoint reuses networking and endpoint security from Lesson 14 and managed identities & Key Vault from Lesson 16.

questions.q: What happens to a deployment created with the shared-quota checkbox?
options: It is automatically deleted after 168 hours
It runs forever at no cost
It immediately fails to deploy
It requires a credit card to enable
questions.explain: Shared quota borrows temporary Microsoft-provided quota for testing, with the trade-off that the endpoint is automatically deleted after 168 hours.

questions.q: According to this lesson, what is the most common way this capstone actually stalls?
options: Choosing a programming language the student doesn't know
The Foundry portal being unavailable
Not having an Azure account at all
Picking a model or configuration big enough that quota or cost delays it for days
questions.explain: The lesson calls out scope, not technical difficulty, as the most common reason this capstone stalls — an oversized model or deployment choice can turn into a multi-day quota or cost delay.

questions.q: What does this lesson ask you to write down before moving on to Lesson 22?
options: A full architecture diagram of the finished system
A list of every Azure region in the world
Which model, which deployment option, and whether you'll use shared quota
The exact dollar cost of the entire capstone
questions.explain: The lab asks for a short, concrete plan: the model, the deployment option (managed compute or serverless), and whether shared quota will be used — exactly what Lesson 22 acts on.
